description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No.2103/33, That Published the Function & Duties of Ministers
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific ministerial titles (e.g., "Minister of Defence," "Minister of Finance & Mass Media") and detailed portfolio responsibilities (e.g., "Sri Lanka Police," "Comptroller General's Office," "Rehabilitation of Persons, Properties and Industries Authority"). It amends previous notifications by adding, removing, and modifying specific functions and institutions under each minister's purview, making it a Hybrid gazette that includes both who holds the positions and what they are responsible for.
